executionRole.purpose: ECS runtime startup, image retrieval, and log delivery
allowedCapabilities: Pull image from the service-scoped ECR repository
Write container logs to the service-scoped CloudWatch log group

taskRole.purpose: Runtime identity for the Flask foundation container
futureConditionalCapabilities: Read service-scoped parameters from AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store
Read service-scoped secrets from AWS Secrets Manager

futureGithubOidcDeploymentRole.purpose: Future GitHub Actions deployment identity without long-lived AWS secrets
allowedCapabilities: Push image to the service ECR repository
Update the ECS service to a new task definition
forbiddenCapabilities: Long-lived AWS keys in GitHub secrets

notes: Not an IAM policy or trust policy.
Do not store real credentials or live ARNs here.
